name: Circuit Zolder
notes: Circuit Zolder, today's 4.011 km layout as raced by the DTM in 2020 (twice). Raceway loop over the members of OSM relation 6006460 (Circuit Zolder). A separate id from dtm-1991's zolder, which is the 1991 Group A track with Group A speeds. speed_scale 1.0 is uncalibrated; tyre_wear_mult as the base's Valencia.
